obfuscation_indicators: typically able to pass higher prices
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and quantitatively detailed, with strong sales, pricing, liquidity, leverage, and capital allocation metrics supporting a favorable tone. Key risks include cyclical demand, metal-price volatility, working-capital consumption, fixed-cost rigidity, and reliance on passing higher input costs to customers. Some forward-looking and self-congratulatory language is qualitative, but it does not materially obscure the financial risks presented.
